title: Which of a Victorian grocery chain's eight stores gets its one 25-person relief crew for the four trading weeks to Christmas Eve 2026, placed where it will work the most hours the stores' casual call-ins would otherwise leave unworked, and the crew hours it will work there
subdomain: discrete-choice-limited-dependent-variable-modeling (each casual's accept-or-decline choice on a call-in offer, fitted on the offer log with the offer's position against the casual's own rostered shift as a term, and run through the call-in module over the published Christmas rosters)
prompt_shape: a committed store and its crew hours in a one-page placement brief with a chart of every store's expected unworked hours, and two tables: last Christmas's call-ins by store (hours put out, covered and left uncovered, 24 cells) and cover across stores in those weeks (each store's call-in hours covered by other stores' casuals and its casuals' hours covered elsewhere, 16 cells)
